id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_150.pack|cs_: "Sylvando! Don't go! I don't want to say goodbye after all!
"I'm so sad to say goodbye to you too.
"But we must beat Mordegon, who steals everyone's smiles. This is a short goodbye.
"...No matter how far apart we are, we'll always be companions!
"Sylvando! Call us anytime you're in trouble! We'll come running wherever you are!
Sylvando can now use the Hit Parade pep power with {var:1}!
"...Thanks for putting up with my selfishness! {var:1}, I'm all yours again!
"By the way, my ship, the Salty Stallion, is moored on the beach east of town. Sail her freely as before!
"...Before boarding, let's head north to Mount Pang Lai, tied to the Luminary. We need a clue to beat Mordegon.
"With a ship, we can reach places we couldn't before. {var:1}, let's keep searching for friends and head to Arboria."
